outcomes.text: Build programming and AI knowledge while considering societal effects and ethical questions.
Apply and assess AI in the student’s chosen field.

requirements.title: Minimum coursework
requirements.summary: At least six courses and 18 credits. Full foundation and elective distribution remains unextracted; this is not an unrestricted choose-six pool.

requirements.title: Grade requirement
requirements.summary: Every course must receive a letter grade of C or better.

requirements.title: Published course approvals
requirements.summary: MAE 3200 also satisfies the Machine Learning foundation category; INFO 3170 is an approved elective. Course metadata and the full pool remain unverified.

requirements.title: Foundation/elective reuse
requirements.summary: Human-AI Interaction and Ethics, Governance & Policy foundation courses may serve as electives only when not used for a foundation requirement; forbidden overlap rules also apply and require catalog review.

requirements.title: Application timing
requirements.summary: Apply after completing all required courses at C or better, or in the final undergraduate semester while enrolled in the remaining courses.
